parole.testo: From Old Swedish lavi, possibly from the root of loge (“kind of barn”). The other version derives it to Slavic origins, through Finnish. Ultimately from Proto-Balto-Slavic *lā́ˀwāˀ. Cognate with modern Russian лавка (lavka) and modern Finnish lava.

parole.significato: a towerlike building atop a mine shaft, common in Scandinavia during 19th century
